In contrast, the same file's job code (Jobs::PollFeed) iterates `rss.items.each` and TopicRetriever explicitly rescues URI::InvalidURIError, showing the codebase anticipates malformed URIs elsewhere. A string like 'http://bad url' passes the regex but raises URI::InvalidURIError inside the hourly poll loop, aborting the whole import. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls` does `uri = URI(url)` with no rescue (app/models/topic_embed.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` only guards with `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which can still allow malformed URLs that raise `URI::InvalidURIError` (e.g., bad port/characters) and will bubble up. In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, the import runs inside `rss.items.each` with no exception handling, so one bad feed item URL could abort the whole import loop/job.
